# The Test Suite for Requirement U24-3

Feature: System's self-containment and data privacy
  As a user, I want the system to be self-contained and not share any data with third parties
  My system should not share any data with external entities like Chemists and Labs

Scenario: Chemists log in and access prescriptions
  In order to access their prescriptions, Chemists should log in to the system
  Given the Chemist has valid credentials
  When they log in using the credentials
  Then they should see their own prescriptions without any third-party data

Scenario: Patients receive emails with prescriptions and invoice
  As a patient, I want to receive emails with my full prescription and invoice
  Given I have received a prescription
  And the system is configured to send emails
  When I request an email to be sent
  Then I should receive an email with the full prescription and invoice

Scenario: Payment interface with standard Payment Gateway
  As a patient, I want to use the standard Payment Gateway available with the Hospital
  Given the system integrates with the Payment Gateway
  When I choose to pay via Debit/Credit Cards or Net banking
  Then I should be redirected to a secure payment form

Scenario: Secure payment acceptance
  As a patient, I want to securely accept payments via Debit/Credit Cards or Net banking
  Given I am at the payment interface
  When I select a payment method
  Then the system should process the payment securely
